what: A round glow of 220px radius (text color at 16%, fading out at 70% toward the edge) sticks to the cursor in screen blend mode over the list and logo grid, turning on in .35s when it enters the panel and off when it leaves — like shining a flashlight over dark list rows

options.--fx-power: Light strength (share of text color), default 16%

from.where: list.html .pi__glow (work index — original ProjectIndex-glow) · about.html .ab-partners__glow (logo grid — original Partners-glow · radial-gradient circle 220px · opacity .35s ease · mix-blend screen)

note: The light is drawn with ::after on the panel so it does not block links inside (pointer-events none). It is not enabled on touch devices
